div.head: Nor Grið 6
div.ab: [Schluss von 2.] 3. Und einem Priester[?] sind Kirchgänge verboten [mit] Weibern und Waffen.
[End of clause 2.] 3. And for a priest[?], church-goings with women and weapons are forbidden.
always according to the status of the site.
div.note: Clause 3 begins at the end of this line and runs over lines 7–8. The ‘e’ of ‘[mæ]r[þ]e’ cannot be made out; Warner reads letter 3 or 2 as rather ‘t’, and ‘áá’ as illegible. Liebermann supplies ‘mid’ before ‘wifum’.
